title: LLM Calls Are the New Blind Spot
summary: Python services calling LLM providers in production typically show up in traces as a generic outgoing HTTP call to api.openai.com. No model, no tokens, no finish reason. Odigos has bundled seven OpenTelemetry GenAI instrumentations into the Python auto-instrumentation distro so those spans show up automatically, with no code changes.
body_markdown: Python services calling LLM providers in production typically show up in traces as a generic outgoing HTTP call to api.openai.com. No model, no tokens, no finish reason.
